title: Portrait of a Humanist
alt: A bearded man with shoulder-length dark brown hair, in a dark robe over a white shirt, looks directly at us against an emerald-green curtain. Beside him a shelf covered with green holds a globe, an open book filled with text, a stack of closed books, and a quill resting in an inkwell.

title: Allegory of Music
alt: A woman in flowing pastel robes sits on a bank of clouds and points to a lyre propped against her knee, while a winged putto reaches forward to strum its strings and another hovers above with a laurel wreath and a flute. Two white doves support an open book of sheet music beneath her elbow.

title: Saint Jerome
alt: An elongated, white-bearded man, nearly nude, kneels at the opening of a dark rocky cave, one arm along an open book and the other hand gripping a rock, and raises his face towards rays of yellow and white light in a turquoise sky at the upper left.

title: Moonlight
alt: A full moon shines through slate-grey clouds over a rippling sea, its light reflected down the centre of the water. On the curving beach people gather round a fire by a tent, men haul a small boat ashore, and tall masted ships stand against the night sky, with a walled town and a lighthouse in the distance.
